values: Standardized way for project owners to report progress so management has real-time visibility across all active projects.
• Each Project Owner keeps the tracker up to date.
• Update at least every Friday before the Weekly Scrum, or right after a major milestone.
• Progress reflects actual completed work, not estimates.
• Each module has exactly one assigned owner.
• Keep supporting evidence (Jira, PRs, UAT reports, deployment records) available if requested.
How to Update Each SDLC Phase
0-100% based on completion of business requirements and stakeholder approval.
Based on completed workflows, process analysis, use cases, technical requirements.
Based on approved wireframes, mockups, or design prototypes.
% of coding completed for the module.
Update after peer review or technical lead approval.
Update after completed functional, regression, or integration testing.
Update after successful business user validation and acceptance.
Update after deployment to the target environment and validation.
Update once technical docs, user guides, or release notes are done.
Update after post-deployment monitoring and stabilization.
